sections.title: Tree and habitat
sections.text: Pradosia grisebachii is a lowland tropical tree described to about 15 m. It grows in non-flooded forest on clay soils, at roughly 100–700 m elevation.

sections.title: Leaves, flowers and fruit
sections.text: Its alternate or nearly whorled leaves are about 8–22 × 4–8 cm. Reddish flowers grow on the branches; the smooth, pale-yellow ellipsoid drupes are about 3.5–5 cm long.

sections.title: Taxonomy and food
sections.text: The taxonomic revision treats P. atroviolacea as a synonym of P. grisebachii. No food use for the fruit is established in the sources consulted.
